title: Discipleship
definition: Discipleship is the lifelong process of following Jesus, learning His Word, obeying His commands, and helping others do the same.
summary: A disciple is not merely a listener but a follower of Christ. Discipleship involves teaching, obedience, growth, correction, and mission.
christFocus: Jesus calls people to follow Him and be transformed into His likeness.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: A disciple is not merely a listener but a follower of Christ. Discipleship involves teaching, obedience, growth, correction, and mission.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
